$description: MegaMenu (platform/components/MegaMenu, library wave 5, lane A): its component tokens. The panel is Popover's (size auto), the button is a ghost Button, the links are standalone Links and the accordion is NavList.

mega-menu-sections-margin-block-start.$description: MegaMenu accordion: the space between the button and its groups.

mega-menu-row-gap.$description: MegaMenu: the gap between rows of columns that wrapped.

mega-menu-column-width.$description: MegaMenu: the width of one group's column.

mega-menu-heading-text.$description: MegaMenu: the group heading's color (as Menu's group label).

mega-menu-heading-margin-block-end.$description: MegaMenu: the space under a group heading.

mega-menu-link-gap.$description: MegaMenu: the gap between the links of a group.

mega-menu-feature-background.$description: MegaMenu: the featured area's fill (the sunken surface).

mega-menu-feature-radius.$description: MegaMenu: the featured area's corners (the card radius).
